name: The Silence Beneath the Sands

rooms.name: Sand-Choked Entrance
rooms.description: A sloped shaft cut into the bedrock opens under a drift of wind-piled sand. The air beyond is still, dry, and carries the faint mineral smell of three thousand sealed years.

rooms.name: Descending Passage
rooms.description: A long, narrow corridor angles downward, its walls crowded with faded hieroglyphs and figures of the sun god. Sand hisses underfoot with every step.

rooms.name: Antechamber of Offerings
rooms.description: Painted niches line the walls, each holding desiccated food offerings, jars of wine turned to vinegar, and small wooden servant figures. Dust lies thick and undisturbed over everything.

rooms.name: Chamber of the Four Sons
rooms.description: Four canopic jars stand in a stone chest at the center of the room, their stoppers carved as a man, a jackal, a baboon, and a falcon. Something wet glistens at the base of the jackal-headed jar.

rooms.name: Scribe's Alcove
rooms.description: A cramped side chamber where a wooden palette of dried ink cakes and reed brushes still sits on a low bench. Half-finished columns of hieroglyphs cover the wall, the last line trailing off mid-symbol.

rooms.name: Collapsed Gallery
rooms.description: Half the ceiling has come down here, burying the floor under slabs of limestone and drifts of sand. Pale roots from the surface have forced through the cracks, and beetles skitter away from the light.

rooms.name: Shrine of the Jackal
rooms.description: A black-painted statue of a jackal-headed god crouches on a plinth, gold leaf still clinging to its ears and snout. Bowls of ancient ash sit at its feet, and the floor tiles before it are worn smooth by kneeling.

rooms.name: False Burial Chamber
rooms.description: An ornate sarcophagus rests on a dais, its lid painted with a serene royal face — but the gilding is flaking plaster, and the walls' inscriptions are crude imitations of the real work deeper in. This room was built to fool robbers.

rooms.name: Well of the Ka
rooms.description: A square shaft drops into absolute darkness in the middle of the floor, its rim carved with prayers for the soul's journey. A cold updraft carries the sound of shifting sand from far below.

rooms.name: Processional Hall
rooms.description: Massive painted columns march the length of this hall, each carved as a bound bundle of reeds. Reliefs show the pharaoh's funeral procession, dozens of tiny figures hauling a boat toward the underworld.

rooms.name: Treasury Annex
rooms.description: Stacks of cedar boxes, alabaster vessels, and folded linen fill the chamber, all labeled with painted cartouches. Most has decayed to shapeless rot, but gold gleams in the gloom where a chest has spilled.

rooms.name: Hall of Weighing
rooms.description: One wall bears a monumental mural: a great balance, a heart on one scale, a feather on the other, and a crocodile-headed beast waiting beneath. A real bronze scale stands before the painting, its pans empty.

rooms.name: Priests' Resting Niche
rooms.description: Three simple mummies lie in shallow wall recesses, wrapped in plain undyed linen — the burial priests who sealed this tomb and never left. Clay seals stamped with their names are scattered on the floor.

rooms.name: Serpent Cleft
rooms.description: The passage narrows to a crawl through a crack in the rock, and the stones are slick with old dust. Carved cobras rear from both walls, their painted eyes following anyone who squeezes through.

rooms.name: Chamber of the Barque
rooms.description: A full-sized wooden funerary boat rests on stone cradles, astonishingly preserved, its prow shaped like a papyrus blossom. Oars lie stacked beside it, ready for a voyage that never came.

rooms.name: Sanctum of the Sealed Door
rooms.description: A massive stone door sealed with unbroken plaster and the royal cartouche blocks the way onward. Guardians painted at life size flank it, spears raised, and the floor before it is stained a rust-dark brown.

rooms.name: Burial Chamber of the Pharaoh
rooms.description: Gold. The walls are sheathed in it, and a towering red granite sarcophagus dominates the center beneath a ceiling painted with stars. A hulking figure of stone and bandage-wrapped bone stands motionless beside the coffin, and its eyes ignite with cold blue fire.

rooms.name: Robbers' Escape Shaft
rooms.description: A crude tunnel hacked upward through the ceiling rock, left by ancient tomb robbers, lets a single thread of daylight and falling sand spill into the gloom. Faded rope fibers still cling to the shaft's lip.
